title: Classify GP8 limits for binary-only score metadata
scope: Resolve export gaps for Writer, Comments, Date, notice boundaries and clipboard provenance without confusing authorship fields.
acceptance: For each field, show a valid non-default public value and its current omission/normalization report.
Check GPIF and archive formats for a supported destination; keep Author and Writer independent.
Implement only verified destinations and classify the remainder as explicit target limits with strict export assertions.
exclusions: Do not hide values in undocumented XML fields or repurpose unrelated credits.

reproduction.instructions: For each field, show a valid non-default public value and its current omission/normalization report.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
target-limit: Distinct Writer, Comments, Date, clipboard provenance and arbitrary notice boundaries cannot use other metadata fields without changing their meaning.

Exercise distinct Writer, Comments, Date and clipboard values plus ambiguous notice boundaries, including embedded newlines and empty entries. Assert current omission/normalization codes and strict behavior. Cross-check the supported GPIF Score fields so Author/Music, Tabber, Instructions and Notices remain independent; do not repurpose one to hide unsupported metadata. If the acceptance cases already pass, record their verified commit and resolve as narrow target limits. A future implementation needs an actual distinct target field and retaining consumer evidence.
